dream: The card boiled until it felt like a warm room. I pressed the dark oak down on the tired wedge until the wood turned into thick paper. The wide anchor slid sideways into the air, dragging the fat stack with it. I lay on top of the sliding stack, feeling heavy and lazy. The fence stood up, but it was made of only three stacked letters. I pressed my hand against the edge of the world, hoping the air would stay still enough to hold me there until the heat broke.
